Despite playing a leading role since the beginning of this now famous anti-piracy initiative, in phase 8 United States authorities did not actively participate. Instead, alongside Mexico, the DoJ and DoC were granted observer status, "to learn about the methodology used in combating digital piracy," Brazil's Ministry of Justice explains.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Operation 404: 3,000+ Pirate Domains Blocked, USDOJ & USDOC Get to Watch

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nhentai Rejects Piracy Claims, Hits Back with $500k Damages Claim for Fraud

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:

Offering lifetime access to movies, TV shows and live sports, an already popular device that claims to evade site-blocking measures may seem like the perfect fit. Unfortunately, mandatory free extras include critical security issues and potential exposure to copyright lawsuits.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Box Evades Blocking But is Also Critically Vulnerable to Attack

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Is downloading a YouTube video a violation of the DMCA's anti-circumvention provision? That is the key question in the legal battle between stream-ripper Yout and the RIAA. Yout argues that because YouTube videos are freely accessible to anyone with a web browser, there are no restrictions. The RIAA counters that Yout is confusing the right to watch a stream with the right to download a copy of the music file.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Yout and RIAA Clash in Court Over YouTube’s Alleged Copyright Barriers

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
The saga surrounding the former operator of NunuTV, once South Korea’s largest pirate streaming site, has taken another wrong turn for the defendant. After receiving a three-year prison sentence earlier this year, an appeal only made the situation worse. After noticing a history of recidivism and a lack of remorse, the court extended the former operator's original three-year sentence by 18 months.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Operator’s Appeal Goes Bad, Court Extends Prison Term By 50%

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Motion Picture Association has its eyes set on the streaming portal OnionPlay. After successfully petitioning Discord to shut down the site's community server, the Hollywood group has secured a DMCA subpoena requiring Discord to unmask the suspected operator. The targeted admin, known as "TexasHomie," does not appear to be overly concerned by this looming threat.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: MPA Shut Down OnionPlay’s Discord & Tries to Unmask Pirate Site Operator

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Six years after massive raids shut down the German cyberlocker Share-Online.biz, this week the site's operator was sentenced to a two-year suspended prison term. The case is seen as a landmark victory in Germany, as it indicates that operators of seemingly "neutral" cyberlocker platforms can be held liable. At the same time, €50 million in revenue and evaporated threats against users leave unanswered questions. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Share-Online Operator Gets Two Years Probation in Landmark ‘Cyberlocker’ Verdict

articles.author: Andy Maxwell

A targeted action by Greek authorities has shut down an IPTV reselling operation, leading to the arrest of one individual and the referral of 68 end users for prosecution. The action marks a shift in Greek law enforcement’s approach to IPTV piracy, arriving on the back of a new law that provides for thousands of euros in fines for both sellers and users.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Greek Cybercrime Unit Shuts Down IPTV Pirates, 68 End Users Face Fines

Download Changelog Bug tracker

articles.description: Bohužel se nekoná překvapení v žádném směru a "Deník" není ani lepší, ani horší, ani méně nebo více zábavný než "Krtkův svět". Snad s výjimkou toho, že Eva Toulová nově dokázala, že kromě nepříliš dobré scenáristky a režisérky je také nepříliš dobrá herečka. Zdaleka největším plusem i tentokrát zůstává, že film má necelých 80 minut. Takže příště už asi nepůjdeme... (Ilča 10 %)

articles.description: Pravděpodobně chápu, o co tvůrcům šlo, a jak chtěli prolínat depresivní vězeňské drama s muzikálovou exhibicí, ale realizovali to extrémně neobratně a přítomnost Jennifer Lopezové je spíše na škodu. (Ilča 40 %)

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Druhý film je přesně tak špatný, jak jsem se obával u prvního filmu (který mě docela příjemně překvapil). Jistě to do nějaké míry souvisí i s tím, že celé univerzum "FNAF" je mimo moje chápání a hry jsem nehrál. Ale v tomto filmu opravdu nebylo vůbec nic, co by mě jakýmkoliv způsobem zaujalo. Což je překvapivé, neboť je od stejných tvůrců jako jednička. (Ilča 20 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Pět nocí u Freddyho 2 [Five Nights at Freddy's 2] - 20 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Velká hromada vteřinových (i kratších) gagů, většinou nápaditě předabovaných, takže fungovaly i v češtině. U některých jsem se dokonce zasmál. Ale hlavně aby se pořád bum, bum něco dělo a divák nemohl začít přemýšlet. Jinak žádné překvapení. Nudná a předvídatelná zápletka, spousta protixenofobních a protirasistických poučení (rysové mají bílé privilegium!) a vizuálně nic extra - především kulisy v pozadí mi přišly podivně bez hloubky. (Ilča 60 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Zootropolis: Město zvířat 2 [Zootopia 2] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Zajímavý námět je poněkud rozmělněn zbytečně dlouhou stopáží a specifickým humorem, se kterým jsem se občas míjel. Takže se kacířsky těším, až vznikne nevyhnutelný hollywoodský remake. (Ilča 90 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Není jiná možnost [No Other Choice / 어쩔수가없다] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Po prvním filmu jsem choval naději, že příběh je pouze nakousnut a o rok později se uzavře a epicky vyvrcholí. Bohužel, druhý film vypadá podstatně laciněji, je mnohen hůř zrežírovaný a chybí mu všechno to, co činilo první film aspoň snesitelným. A děj nedává smysl nejen v návaznosti na starého "Čaroděje ze země Oz", ale ani v návaznosti na první "Čarodějku", což je vskutku bizarní. (Ilča 30 %)

articles.description:
Illia Volochii discovered that urllib3 did not limit the steps in a
decompression chain. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
urllib3 to use excessive resources, causing a denial of service.
(CVE-2025-66418)

Rui Xi discovered that urllib3 incorrectly handled highly compressed data.
An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause urllib3 to use excessive
resources, causing a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu
24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 25.04, and Ubuntu 25.10. (CVE-2025-66471)

For the brotli encoding, the fix for CVE-2025-66471 requires an additional
security update in the brotli package.
articles.title: USN-7927-1: urllib3 vulnerabilities

articles.description:
Kay discovered that OpenStack Keystone incorrectly handled the ec2tokens
and s3tokens APIs. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
obtain unauthorized access and escalate privileges. (CVE-2025-65073)

It was discovered that OpenStack Keystone only validated the first 72
bytes of an application secret. An attacker could possibly use this issue
to bypass password complexity. (CVE-2021-3563)

It was discovered that OpenStack Keystone had a time lag before a token
should be revoked by the security policy. A remote administrator could use
this issue to maintain access for longer than expected. (CVE-2022-2447)
articles.title: USN-7926-1: OpenStack Keystone vulnerabilities

articles.description:
It was discovered that c-ares incorrectly handled terminating certain
queries after a maximum number of attempts. An attacker could possibly use
this issue to cause c-ares to crash, resulting in a denial of service.
articles.title: USN-7925-1: c-ares vulnerability

articles.description:
It was discovered that libpng incorrectly handled memory when processing
certain PNG files, which could result in an out-of-bounds memory access.
If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially
crafted PNG file, an attacker could use this issue to cause libpng to
crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-64505)

It was discovered that libpng incorrectly handled memory when processing
8-bit images through the simplified write API with 'convert_to_8bit'
enabled, which could result in an out-of-bounds memory access. If a user
or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted 8-bit
PNG file, an attacker could use this issue to cause libpng to crash,
resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-64506)

It was discovered that libpng incorrectly handled memory when processing
palette images with 'PNG_FLAG_OPTIMIZE_ALPHA' enabled, which could result
in an out-of-bounds memory access. If a user or automated system were
tricked into opening a specially crafted PNG file, an attacker could use
this issue to cause libpng to crash, resulting in a denial of service.
(CVE-2025-64720)

It was discovered that libpng incorrectly handled memory when processing
6-bit interlaced PNGs with 8-bit output format, which could result in an
out-of-bounds memory access. If a user or automated system were tricked
into opening a specially crafted PNG file, an attacker could use this
issue to cause libpng to crash, resulting in a denial of service.
(CVE-2025-65018)
articles.title: USN-7924-1: libpng vulnerabilities
